text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, partner. Our first goal of the 
year, the Hanshin Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta stake my claim as the strongest. 
Starting with this race and the next Tenno 
Sho (Spring)."
choice_data_list: Yeah, our biggest rival today is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Narita Top Road. One of the powerhouse 
Umamusume of the T.M. Opera O generation, 
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I don't get the impression they're 
exceptionally strong. Feels like they're 
second or third fiddle in the Opera O 
generation."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Her running is solid, but for better or 
worse, it lacks an edge of intimidation. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I know because we're roommates, but that 
girl is just dead serious about 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Every morning, I wake up strictly on time 
and go for roadwork. And that's 365 days a 
year, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
When I get back to the room, she's often 
working out or stretching. The driving 
force behind that is...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she really just wants to catch up to 
Opera O after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's just a wild guess. I won't 
know what she's truly hiding deep down 
until we run against each other again.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Defeat the strongest, and you're the 
strongest. That's what I thought, but my 
benefactor in Hokkaido says I'm not there 
yet. Which means...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(So there really are others in the Twinkle 
Series right now... Other contenders for 
the strongest.)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (I don't know who that is. However...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Fine by me. I'll run and see it for 
myself. First up is you, Top Road!"
